title: About
description: About the artist, and where to find their work.

text: This is a curated visual art stream that I created. It displays an ongoing series of relevant work and offers select pieces for sale in a variety of media. It is not a complete representation of my work and is a separate project.

So many great things, not just art, have emerged out of failure of one kind or another. One could argue that failure is intrinsic to “progress” of any sort. I find this fascinating as my work strongly embodies this tension by default.
Rather than provide a series of boring explanations which would only serve to diminish the work, here are a few important questions to consider:
• What does it mean in the context of art for a work to have failed? To have been successful?

• Can the idea of failure itself be utilized as an artistic medium and if so, what happens to the work and the viewer’s perception of it as it endlessly doubles back on itself in a ceaseless effort to remain as such and thereby destabilize everything around it?

• What kind of reaction do I expect to get from others with this work? Should they “like” it and if so does that mean I have failed? And if that’s true, couldn’t I count that as having been successful after all? Lather, rinse, repeat.
• Is this work brilliant, merely good, or completely full of shit? I’m not sure and I hope it stays that way.
